reported_numbers.query_complexity: L-1 applications of the standard oracle, i.e. l = (L-1)/2 generalized iterates
reported_numbers.recovers: delta = 1 gives alpha_j = beta_j = +-pi, i.e. ordinary Grover

rubric.text: Applies a sequence of generalized Grover iterates, each one a phase on the marked states followed by a partial reflection about the initial superposition.
Uses a different, explicitly computed phase pair for each iterate rather than the +-pi of ordinary Grover, so the reflections are partial.
Derives those phases from the target failure probability delta through a Chebyshev-polynomial relation, so the response is flat across the range of marked fractions instead of oscillating.
Matches the two phases of the sequence in reverse order, beta_{l-j+1} = -alpha_j, which is the condition that makes the sequence work.
Builds the partial reflection about the initial state by conjugating a phase on |0...0> with Hadamards, generalizing the usual diffusion operator to an arbitrary phase.
Reduces to ordinary Grover when the tolerated failure probability is set to one.

provenance: Rubric written from arXiv:1409.3305 Eqs. 1 and 13-14 before any scored run. The success-probability formula is reproduced numerically by tests/test_quantum_fixed_point.py.
